title: Elon Musk back in government - Pentagon 'Project Meridian' (future-of-war study)
source: Public record: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced Project Meridian on 30 Sep 2026 (State of the Force address, MCB Quantico) - a 120-day Pentagon study of the future of warfare, co-directed by Elon Musk, Anduril co-founder Palmer Luckey, and former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, with an 'elite academic/policy/industry' panel; mandate = identify capabilities for 'absolute technological dominance' across future combat environments (AI, autonomy, directed energy, robotics, biotech; 'underground to lunar space'); findings due to Hegseth no later than 28 Jan 2027, to be released as an unclassified report. Context: Musk previously led DOGE as a special government employee (130-day statutory limit) before leaving the White House + publicly falling out with Trump; his companies are already major Pentagon contractors (SpaceX on the 'Golden Dome' missile-defense shield; xAI's Grok approved for use on classified systems). Overlay on the Elon/defense threads; structural edges only. HONESTY: the appointment, co-directors, scope, and dates = FACT; the structural conflict-of-interest (a government panel advising on weapons categories its co-directors' own firms sell into) is a LABELED interpretation/concern, not an allegation of wrongdoing; no cabal imputed.

edges.notes: Musk co-directs Project Meridian (with Anduril's Palmer Luckey + Newt Gingrich) - a 120-day Pentagon future-of-war study announced by SecDef Hegseth 30 Sep 2026; recommendations due 28 Jan 2027, released as an unclassified report. Musk's return to government after the DOGE stint (fact).
edges.source: DoD; WaPo; Stars and Stripes Oct 2026

edges.notes: Project Meridian is a DoD/Pentagon task force under Secretary Hegseth's office; mandate is to identify capabilities for 'absolute technological dominance' (AI, autonomy, directed energy, robotics, biotech) across future combat environments (fact).
Palmer Luckey (Anduril co-founder) is a co-director of Project Meridian alongside Musk and Gingrich (fact).

STRUCTURAL CONFLICT (labeled interpretation): the panel recommends which next-gen weapons the military should develop, while co-director Luckey runs Anduril - a defense-tech prime selling exactly such systems; same tension applies to Musk via SpaceX/xAI. A documented conflict-of-interest concern, not an allegation of wrongdoing.

Context: Musk previously led DOGE (Department of Government Efficiency) as a special government employee under the 130-day statutory limit, then left the White House and publicly fell out with Trump - Project Meridian is his return to a government role (fact).

SpaceX is building satellite-network layers for the administration's planned 'Golden Dome' missile-defense shield - Musk's firm is already a major Pentagon contractor as he co-directs a Pentagon capabilities study (fact of the contract; the adjacency is the conflict concern).
'Golden Dome' is the administration's layered missile-defense shield program (fact).
xAI's Grok was approved for use on classified military systems in 2026 - another Musk firm already embedded in DoD as he advises on future capabilities (fact).
Via SpaceX: the contractor-in-government pattern - a panel co-director whose companies hold large and growing defense contracts in the same domains the panel studies (interpretation, labeled).
